outcome: changes in trophoblast transcriptome and metabolism
expression of GLUT1, glycolytic enzymes, and glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase
cohort: This study used a trophoblast cell line cultured in a fluidic flow system, as well as first trimester and term placental explants.
finding: Fluid shear stress induces a shift from glycolytic to amino acid metabolism in human trophoblasts, potentially contributing to intrauterine growth restriction when excessive.
